verse.text: As you endure this divine discipline, remember that God is treating you as his own children. Who ever heard of a child who is never disciplined by its father?

reflection: Discipline can feel like the least fun part of fatherhood, but Hebrews reminds us it's actually proof of love, not the absence of it — a good dad corrects because he's invested in who his kids become. When you set a boundary or follow through on a consequence tonight, remember you're not being harsh; you're mirroring the way your Heavenly Father trains and shapes you. The goal isn't control, it's character — theirs and yours.
